purpose: Teach: 連敗/概観/旧来/番地/大口/取り決め/売り手/融通

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合に連敗するな
lines.en: We can't keep losing to our competitors.
lines.style: Sharp, direct opening. Clipped consonants. Eyes steady on Kenji. Measured pace—not rushed, but authoritative. The tone of someone stating a fact that demands action.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界全体の概観を資料にまとめました
lines.en: Yes. I've compiled a full industry overview into a report.
lines.style: Respectful but assured. Even delivery—each phrase landing with quiet competence. No hesitation. Shows he's already thinking ahead, not just reacting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 旧来の商品ラインも維持しろ
lines.en: And maintain our traditional product lines.
lines.style: Brief, economical. Slightly lower in register—a secondary point but non-negotiable. No room for questions. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新店舗の番地が確定しました
lines.en: Yes. The address for the new storefront has been confirmed.
lines.style: Clear, factual report. Steady voice—no apology in the delivery. Shows progress. Slightly faster than the last exchange, moving forward with momentum.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様の大口注文に対応しろ
lines.en: And respond to our major clients' large orders.
lines.style: Firm emphasis on 'respond'—this matters. Slight pause before it. Low, deliberate tone. Not loud, but carries weight. The voice of someone protecting key relationships.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お取引先と価格の取り決めを更新しました
lines.en: Yes. I've updated the pricing agreements with our partners.
lines.style: Confident, matter-of-fact. No hedging. Shows he's already handled it. Quick, efficient delivery—the tone of someone who understands priorities and acts on them.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、売り手市場の優位を活かせ
lines.en: And leverage our advantage in this seller's market.
lines.style: Slightly more expansive than the previous directives. Measured confidence—the opening attack is clear, but the delivery has a subtle forward momentum. The voice of strategic thinking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様のご要望に融通を利かせます
lines.en: Yes. I'll be flexible with our valued clients' requests.
lines.style: Assured, closing statement. Warm undertone beneath the professionalism—shows he understands the human side of business. Even delivery that signals both competence and reliability. This is the end.
